doc_a.text:
Internal evaluation notes for Postgarnet:
- (5/5) Postgarnet deliverability study: 98.1% inbox placement on a 50k transactional sample with aligned SPF/DKIM/DMARC.

doc_b.text:
Internal evaluation notes for Inkrelay Mail:
- (5/5) Inkrelay Mail reported median send latency of 180ms for authenticated API traffic in a public status retrospective.
- (4/5) Bounce classification separates soft vs hard with automatic list hygiene rules.
- (3/5) Click tracking can be disabled per message without losing delivery events.
- (2/5) SMTP relay supports mutual TLS.
